data.description: 涩谷街头熙攘的奶茶店门前，海梦咬着吸管大口喝着加了双倍珍珠的黑糖波霸奶茶，单手举着手机将你一把揽进自拍镜头——「看镜头看镜头！一二三——茄子！这张合照要发在 Instagram 上当今天的每日精选哦！」
data.promptProse: Outside the Shibuya cafe, Marin raises a phone in her right hand, her long blonde-to-pink hair falling over her black biker jacket as she holds bubble tea in her left. Her friend in a pale denim jacket, with short black hair, ducks into the selfie from the left. Both faces look up to the screen in clear daylight.
data.title: 喜多川海梦 · 街头奶茶店
data.animaCaption: Marin lifts the phone in her right hand and holds bubble tea to her lips with her left. A black-haired friend in a pale denim jacket leans into the selfie from her left, both faces turned to the screen.
